title: Functoriality of the plus construction
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. For a presheaf of sets $\mathcal F$ on $\mathcal C$ let $\mathcal F^+$, the classes $[\mathcal U,s]$ ($\mathcal U$ a covering of $U$, $s\in H^0(\mathcal U,\mathcal F)$) and $\theta_{\mathcal F}:\mathcal F\to\mathcal F^+$ be as in [def-weil-pbc-site-plus-construction]. Let $\varphi:\mathcal F\to\mathcal G$ be a morphism of presheaves of sets. Then: (a) the rule $\varphi^+_U([\mathcal U,(s_i)_i])=[\mathcal U,(\varphi_{U_i}(s_i))_i]$ gives a well-defined map $\varphi^+_U:\mathcal F^+(U)\to\mathcal G^+(U)$ for every object $U$, and these maps form a morphism of presheaves $\varphi^+:\mathcal F^+\to\mathcal G^+$; (b) $\theta_{\mathcal G}\circ\varphi=\varphi^+\circ\theta_{\mathcal F}$; (c) $(\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal F})^+=\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal F^+}$ and $(\psi\circ\varphi)^+=\psi^+\circ\varphi^+$ for a second morphism $\psi:\mathcal G\to\mathcal H$. In other words $\mathcal F\mapsto(\theta_{\mathcal F}:\mathcal F\to\mathcal F^+)$ is a functor and $\theta$ is a natural transformation from the identity to it.

source.place: Sites, Lemma 00W5 (lemma-plus-functorial), whose proof in the source only states the square to be checked; the map on $H^0$ is the evident one of Section 00W1

mathlib_searches.verdict: generalization in another formalism: plusMap (Plus.lean:150), plusMap_id (:163), plusMap_comp (:179), toPlus_naturality (:213) for `plusObj` over a Grothendieck topology; Mathlib's plus construction `plusObj` is defined for a Grothendieck topology (colimit over covering sieves `J.Cover X`), not for a site given by covering families as in Stacks 00VH [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] with the plus construction of [def-weil-pbc-site-plus-construction]; the identification of the two plus constructions is itself a theorem (cofinality of the sieves generated by covering families, Stacks Sites Sections 00ZB/00ZG), so this is not a one-line specialization
